name: grimmsnarl_ml_v4
deck_note: Unchanged from v1/v2/v3: the list 21 of the top-50 Grimmsnarl teams run card for card.
teacher_selection_note: Pin unchanged from v2/v3, and this version is the reason not to change it: measured per own turn, v3 diverges from THIS pilot by 8.4 points on the dark-energy attachment (75.1% against 83.5%), 7.0 on the Grimmsnarl ex evolve and 19.2 on the mirror Froslass evolve. The gap to close is to the pin we already have, not to a different one, so re-pinning would trade a measured 8-point divergence for the unmeasured 12.3%-of-decisions bet v3 found when pinning the 1220.2 pilot everywhere.
policy: Imitation ranker over the top-50 Marnie's Grimmsnarl ex corpus, plus a one-ply route planner. The v4 LightGBM lambdarank booster (1,238 trees, 822 board/action features plus the teacher-id feature) is fitted without outcome or rating weights on 287,828 decisions from 3,655 games and 21 pilots sharing one deck list; inference pins pilot 16494330. v4 adds 28 columns over v3 in three groups. (1) The cost of closing the turn: v3 had a column for every reason to attach a Dark Energy - energy_enables_munkidori is the 7th-highest-gain feature in the model - and none for the cost of not attaching, but the argmax is a comparison between candidates, so ends_turn_wasting_attachment / ends_turn_leaving_munkidori_dry / ends_turn_wasted_enabling_count price what END and attack throw away. Punk Up attaches only to 'your Marnie's Pokemon', so the once-per-turn hand attachment is the only way a Munkidori is ever fuelled. (2) Battle Cage in the Freezing Shroud ledger, which is a correctness fix: Battle Cage stops damage counters on Benched Pokemon from the OPPONENT's Abilities, so our Froslass is blocked on their Bench but not on our own or either Active, making Freezing Shroud strictly worse for us where v3's stadium-blind count said the opposite. (3) The shroud priced three checkups deep and prize-weighted rather than one checkup deep, which is why v3's Froslass guard could never fire. ml_planner keeps v3's three dominance rules and adds _wall_unlock: it refuses to close the turn - by the swing or by passing - while the opponent's Active is damage-immune, the swing takes no prize anywhere, a gust is legal, a body Shadow Bullet damages sits on their Bench and our Active is a fuelled Grimmsnarl ex. Multi-pick, skill-order, discard and face-down prize choices stay with marnies_grimmsnarl_ex_v7.
validation_scope: 116 v4 tests pass (102 inherited from v3 plus 14 pinning the wall-unlock rule's firing and its stand-down conditions, the Battle Cage sides of the shroud ledger, and shroud_checkups_to_kill). Repository pytest shows the same pre-existing failures with and without v4, verified by removing the v4 directory and reproducing them; none reference grimmsnarl. OFFLINE, THE 28 NEW COLUMNS BUY NO ACCURACY: v4 scores 0.8503 strict Top-1 on the never-touched per-team chronological test block (n=34,611) against 0.8455 for shipped v3, but retraining v3's OWN feature set with the early-stopping patience raised from 200 to 700 also scores 0.8503 at 3,395 trees. The entire +0.48 is v3 having stopped 2,717 trees early on a flat, noisy validation curve; v1, v2 and v3 all shipped under-trained. What the new columns buy is convergence: v4 reaches the same 0.8503 ceiling in 1,238 trees and is unchanged by patience 700, so it finds the optimum at the default schedule where v3's set does not. Sub-metrics at that ceiling: MAIN 79.55% -> 80.15%, counter placement 84.40% -> 85.34%, genuine divergence 2.44% -> 2.34%, 19 of 21 pilots up. The 28 columns take 1.94% of total model gain, led by munkidori_dry_count at rank 70 of 823. THE TARGETED BEHAVIOUR DID NOT MOVE: teacher-forced through the pinned pilot's 18 held-out games, that pilot makes the dark-energy attachment on 85.33% of its own turns, v3 on 70.67% and v4 on 72.00% - one decision on 75 turns. All-context agreement 91.44% against v3's 91.56% (n=1,706). v4 is closer to the pilot on 3 of 5 per-turn shapes, v3 on 1, tied on 1, every difference one or two decisions. _wall_unlock has fired 0 times across 147 games of stored evidence: a guardrail with a measured firing rate of zero, not a demonstrated fix. OUTCOME: paired local self-play in the mirror is 62-58 against v3 (51.7%, Wilson 42.8-60.4%) and 66-54 against v2 (55.0%, Wilson 46.1-63.4%) over 120 games each; both straddle 50%, so parity. 0 crashes, 0 illegal selects and 0 draws in 47,787 moves at 24-39 ms/move. Ladder rating is NOT measured. Two priorities from the v3 ladder analysis are deliberately NOT implemented because the per-turn teacher rates refute them: banning the 0-effect Shadow Bullet (the field takes that swing on 88.6% of the 666 turns where it is the last thing available, the elite pair on 91.1%) and Adrena-Brain target selection (we take the ability on 97.6% of the turns it is offered against the field's 97.1%; the deficit is fuel, not targeting).
description: v4 re-measures every MAIN behaviour per own turn rather than per MAIN decision, which is what makes the rest of it possible: per decision the teachers appear to attack into a damage-immune wall 18.9% of the time and per turn 88.6%, because a per-decision denominator counts actions per turn rather than choices. On that footing two of the v3 analysis's five priorities are refuted and one is already at parity, and the real defect turns out to be against the pilot v3 is already pinned to - the once-per-turn Dark Energy attachment, made on 75.1% of legal turns against the pin's 83.5% and below all 21 teachers, which is the direct cause of 4.77 Adrena-Brain uses a game against 6.07. The most valuable finding is not about features at all: every version in this line shipped under-trained, because early-stopping patience 200 trips on a flat validation curve and stopped v3 2,717 trees short of its own optimum. At equal patience v3's features and v4's both reach 0.8503, so the 28 new columns buy no accuracy - only convergence, the same ceiling in 1,238 trees instead of 3,395 and without needing the patience raised. What v4 ships on top of that is two genuine correctness fixes in the Freezing Shroud ledger (Battle Cage side-awareness, and pricing the exchange three checkups deep instead of one) and one provable planner rule for the Crustle wall whose measured firing rate is zero. Paired self-play is parity against both v3 (51.7%) and v2 (55.0%). It does not close the attachment gap: three attempts across v3 and v4 have now failed to move a MAIN preference by adding columns, which is the case for the next version being outcome-based rather than imitation-based.
